domai.rule: Valnak awards contextual validated-contribution credits; no fixed rank table. Contribution may include eldris kills, healing/support, control, operational contribution, core assault, and other validated participation. CP25 R/O/Y/G core-break awards are a separate layer in DOMAI_CORE_AWARDS.json; Blue/Violet successful core amounts OPEN. Awards are not halved. Participation windows, recovery and death deductions follow DOMAI_PARTICIPATION_RULES.json; validated contribution scoring remains OPEN.
